Check the documented record layout against a natality file

diagnose_layout.Rd

Looks at the first n records. For each field it computes the share of non-blank values that are not a documented code, or that fall outside every documented range. If the layout is shifted somewhere, a run of bad fields starts at the shift, and FILLER bytes that should be blank are not. Bytes beyond the documented record length are summarised separately.

Usage

diagnose_layout(file, n = 20000L, year = 2025, threshold = 0.01)

# S3 method for class 'natality_diagnosis'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

file

Path to the fixed-width natality file.

n

Number of records to inspect.

year

Data year; see natality_years().

threshold

Fields whose share of undocumented values exceeds this are reported.

x

A natality_diagnosis.

...

Ignored.

Value

An object of class natality_diagnosis: a list with record_lengths (table), fields (one row per field with nonblank and bad shares), anchors (value tables for a few fields with known codes), filler_nonblank, bad_fields, and, for records longer than documented, tail_values and tail_nonblank. It has a print method.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
diagnose_layout("Nat2025PublicUS.c20260624.r20260922.txt")
} # }
